mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 54 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies with a waxing gibbous moon, though the air quality index is at 79. The International Space Station will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has several projects under review, including an Ardent Glen addition and site plans for Milky Way and Liberty Business Park, with a Plan Commission meeting scheduled for November 4th. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.

There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today, alongside live music today at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can catch yoga on October 26th, trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee on October 27th, and more trivia and pizza events on October 28th.
On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following a report of dangerous driving, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor is the delicious Turtle, and the shop opens today at 10:00 AM so you can satisfy your craving.
